prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a polished PIXEL ART GAMEPLAY CHARACTER TARGET sheet for our existing fantasy RPG heroine, with readable face, hair and clothing at small gameplay scale. This is a proposed pixel-art visual target, not a screenshot of the existing game.
Input reference 1: character identity ONLY from the MIDDLE candidate number 2 in the provided three-column anime sheet. Ignore candidates 1 and 3. Reference 2: existing poor-readability game render, supplied ONLY to understand the gameplay medium and elevated camera; improve substantially, do not reproduce its muddy face or blocky torso.
Identity: innocent gentle young adult anime woman, pearl-white chin-length rounded bob, side-swept fringe and visible cheek, lavender violet eyes, small gentle smile. Pale periwinkle blue short shoulder shawl with silver brooch, high-collar ivory dress with long soft sleeves and flared pleated skirt, dark navy waist ribbon, charcoal stockings, delicate taupe ankle boots. Keep this precise outfit, no weapon or bag.
Medium: authentic deliberately placed hard-edged pixel clusters, finite restrained palette, clean single-pixel dark blue-gray outer contour, lighter internal seams, NO smooth anime illustration, NO airbrushing, NO blur, NO fake grid overlay, NO voxel cube body, NO oversized toddler head. Elegant simplified feminine proportions around 5 heads, rounded bob and flowing skirt silhouette. Around 72-80 logical pixels tall per full-body character, face about 12-15 logical pixels across, distinct violet eyes as small clusters with tiny highlights, subtle nose and warm blush, fringe must not obscure both eyes. Pearl white hair lights with cool lavender-gray shadows; warm pale face distinct from hair; periwinkle cape distinct from ivory skirt; readable navy ribbon. No excessive embroidery noise or dithering. Light from upper left.
Composition: a single beautifully organized horizontal reference sheet on a quiet desaturated blue-gray background. LEFT HALF: one large nearest-neighbor enlarged full-body front-three-quarter heroine in relaxed idle pose, feet fully visible, camera elevated about 25-30 degrees as in an orthographic fantasy RPG; face lifted enough to read. RIGHT TOP: two smaller full-body matching pixel sprites, side-three-quarter and back-three-quarter, same scale relative to each other and consistent pixel vocabulary, showing the bob silhouette and shawl. RIGHT BOTTOM: a small gameplay-vignette inset with the SAME front-three-quarter pixel heroine at realistic small on-screen size on restrained warm ivory cobblestone paving with a little grass edging and soft contact shadow; nearby environment low contrast, heroine easily identifiable. Include a tiny same sprite beside this inset on plain background for size judgment. Large close view must be an integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of the same logical pixel design, not a detailed painted portrait.
All characters represent SAME heroine, same head and outfit. Clear generous spacing, no text, no labels, no logos or watermarks. This sheet prioritizes a usable in-game sprite visual target over illustration detail.
note: Generated views illustrate desired readability. They are not guaranteed identical integer-scale sprites nor measured current-game pixel sizes. No game code or models changed.
